_doc: The Timeline of the Realm (systems/realmTimeline.js, ui/actionMenu/timeline.js): the world's borders, wars, crises, reigns and deeds recorded as the game runs, replayed on a map with a year slider. `every` days between frames of the tile→realm grid (a season); each frame keeps only the tiles that changed. Past `frameCap` frames, or `frameBytes` bytes of border changes, the two closest are merged, so old years thin evenly and every frame kept still reconstructs exactly. `eventCap` markers are kept (the least weighty go first by `priority` and size), `townCap` towns (the oldest ruins go first), `warCap` wars (the shortest go first). A battle with fewer than `minBattleDead` dead is not marked; battles within `battleMergeRange` hexes and `battleMergeDays` days of one another share a marker. `text` holds the markers' lines.

text.crownLost: {who} no longer holds the crown of {realm}.
